name: dedup-across-sources-first-wins
description: The same policy text arrives in the system prompt and, with different whitespace, in trustagent.context. Dedup hashes whitespace-collapsed text, so the extension copy is dropped; request_system comes first in the route source order and wins. The pre-dedup count is 2.
